purpose: Development-only chronological transcript chunking screen for large chapter-locator packets
dataset: dataset-v3 development packets with frozen Mistral Medium 2508 agenda inputs

protocol.merge_rule_tested: earliest returned start per agenda item; highest-confidence variant computed offline as a diagnostic

conclusion: Chunking avoided Gemini's 250000 input-token/minute rejection on the measured calls, but did not reliably recover starts on the two-packet development screen. Confidence-based merging recovered one extra target on one packet only; it is unvalidated. Do not use chunking for production routing without a larger development evaluation and a defined cross-window merge rule.
limitations: Only two large packets and four total provider starts were scored.
The second packet had one invalid chunk after the locator's schema retry.
Chunked development prompts used Mistral-generated agendas; fresh holdout packets use the current Gemini 3.1 agenda path.
Provider-reported prompt tokens vary substantially relative to the builder estimate; chunk size must be admitted against measured provider tokens.
